_note: Tracked placeholder from the feasibility probe (deliberately fake personal values). Copy to check24-profile.json (gitignored) and adjust the levers.
_lever_traps: coinsured is the NUMBER OF INSURED PEOPLE, not the count of extra people: 1 = single, 2 = couple. Measured 2026-08-31 on 79 comparable tariffs: 2 is dearer than 1 for 77 of them (median +1.17 EUR/mo). A couple quote left at 1 silently prices a single.

paymentperiod: keep 'year'. With 'month' CHECK24 only lists tariffs that offer monthly billing — measured 2026-08-31: 27 rows instead of 82. The scraped monatlich_eur stays a monthly figure either way.
min_insure_sum is a MINIMUM filter in millions (5 still returns 20/50 Mio tariffs). Premiums are only comparable at the same Deckungssumme.
birthdate is DD.MM.YYYY here, while hausrat wants ISO YYYY-MM-DD.
